title: 第十三章 姐姐，你是逆天魔龙族高贵的公主！
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你是魔族的公主，那男的不应该入赘么？以你高贵的身份，不应该以你的姓氏为主嘛！”

枫溪一本正经地开始胡说八道起来。

准确来说，这就是枫溪的真实想法。

拜托，白玥可是她姐，是逆天魔龙族的公主，流淌着魔神皇枫秀的血脉。

哪怕白玥不能修炼，那也不是人族能配上的！

男的入赘，不是很正常嘛！

“……”

白玥发现自己和枫溪有时候难以说明白。

枫溪觉得这孩子跟白玥一块姓特别好！

还是那句话，要么姓枫要么姓白，总之就是不能姓龙。

“事情不是你这么算的。”

白玥急忙说着，眼中是慌张的情绪，“我和他是因为相爱才在一块的，姓氏根本不重要。”

“这孩子不单单是我的孩子，还是他的孩子。你这样说就不好了。”

白玥还是无法接受枫溪的提议。

因为枫溪的提议超出了她的认知，也在挑战她的三观。原因很简单，圣殿联盟那边的人族基本上是以父亲的姓氏来命名孩子的姓氏。

哪有像枫溪说的那样让她的孩子随自己的姓氏或者是魔神皇枫秀的姓氏。

反正，白玥难以接受。

枫溪淡淡地一笑，沉声道：“既然这孩子不仅仅是你的孩子，也是他的孩子，那么跟谁姓不都可以么？这可是你要忍受十月怀胎，还要遭受一系列的反应带来的沉重代价。”

“既然如此，这孩子跟你姓才是最好的。”

看着白玥皱起的眉头，枫溪理直气壮地说着，“姐，你就是太善良了，容易被人欺负。”

“这不是善良不善良的问题……”

白玥的话再次被枫溪打断了。

她故作严肃地反问着白玥，脸上是认真的神情，“难道不是吗？”

“你可是我的姐姐，是魔族高贵的公主。”

“他本就该敬你。”

“……”

白玥觉得自己跟枫溪真的思想不一样。

她无法接受枫溪那个说法。

“姐，你早晚会明白的。”

枫溪拉着白玥的手往前走，她们已经离开月魔宫了。

Page (1/3)

"You are a princess of the demon clan, shouldn't the man marry you? With your noble status, shouldn't your surname be the main one?"

Fengxi started talking nonsense seriously.

To be precise, this is what Fengxi really thinks.

Please, Bai Yue is her sister, the princess of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan, with the blood of Demon God Emperor Fengxiu flowing through her veins.

Even if Bai Yue can't practice, she's not worthy of the human race!

Isn’t it normal for a man to marry into his wife?

"..."

Bai Yue found that sometimes it was difficult for herself and Fengxi to explain.

Fengxi thinks it’s very good that this child has the same surname as Bai Yue!

Again, the surname is either Feng or Bai, but in short, the surname cannot be Long.

"That's not how you calculated things."

Bai Yue said hurriedly, with panic in his eyes, "He and I are together because we love each other. The last name is not important at all."

"This child is not only my child, but also his child. It's not good for you to say that."

Bai Yue still couldn't accept Fengxi's proposal.

Because Fengxi's proposal went beyond her knowledge and challenged her three views.The reason is simple. The humans in the Temple Alliance basically name their children after their father's surname.

How could she let her child take her own surname or the surname of Demon God Emperor Fengxiu like Feng Xi said.

Anyway, Bai Yue found it hard to accept.

Fengxi smiled faintly and said in a deep voice: "Since this child is not only your child, but also his child, isn't it okay to have anyone's surname? This is a heavy price for you to endure a ten-month pregnancy and suffer a series of reactions."

"In that case, it would be best for this child to have your last name."

Seeing Bai Yue's frown, Fengxi said confidently, "Sister, you are just too kind and easily bullied."

"This is not a question of kindness or not..."

Bai Yue's words were interrupted again by Fengxi.

She asked Bai Yue pretending to be serious, with a serious look on her face, "Isn't it?"

"You are my sister, a noble princess of the demon clan."

"He should respect you."

"..."

Bai Yue felt that she and Feng Xi really had different thoughts.

She couldn't accept Fengxi's statement.

"Sister, you will understand sooner or later."

Fengxi took Bai Yue's hand and walked forward. They had already left the Moon Demon Palace.
